name: @spike/stream-pack
description: A SYNTHETIC stream/blob extension PACK (the platform's own forcing-function for the extensions[] mechanism). A @spike/* package so the CI `--filter='!@spike/*'` excludes it; a workspace member only so pnpm links @rayspec/platform (the pack ENTRY imports defineExtension from it). The `workspace:*` specifiers below are the IN-WORKSPACE form of that dependency and resolve NOWHERE else — a pack shipped from its own repo declares the same two deps on a RELEASED version and installs them: see package.out-of-repo.json + ../../README.md ('Shipping this pack from its own repo'). NO turbo build/typecheck/test task; the pack carries its own build step instead (../../build.mjs + tsconfig.build.json) because loadExtensions loads compiled JavaScript only at deploy time, and a test loads this .ts source through the loader's explicit typeStrippingImporter seam.
